description: This file defines a custom exception class 'GeneralException' for the OFBiz framework, supporting nested exceptions, message lists, and various constructors.

classes.name: GeneralException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending Java's Exception, with support for nested exceptions, message lists, and various constructors.

methods.name: checkException
methods.description: Static method to rethrow exceptions, wrapping them into a GeneralException unless they are Errors or RuntimeExceptions.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Overrides getMessage to include nested exception message if present.

methods.name: getMessageList
methods.description: Returns the list of error messages associated with this exception.

methods.name: getNonNestedMessage
methods.description: Returns the message from this exception without considering nested exceptions.

methods.name: getNested
methods.description: Returns the nested cause if present, otherwise returns this exception.

methods.name: printStackTrace
methods.description: Prints the stack trace to standard error.

methods.name: printStackTrace (overloaded versions)
methods.description: Prints the stack trace to a specified PrintStream or PrintWriter.
